tagline.en: America's first superhighway, absorbed into the Interstate system
tagline.zh: 美国第一条超级公路，后被并入州际公路网

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.zh: 俄亥俄州韦斯特菲尔德中心附近，与 I-71 相接

end.zh: 新泽西州贝尔莫尔，与 I-295 相接

en: I-76 east of the Mississippi is mostly one road wearing a newer number: the Pennsylvania Turnpike. The Interstate begins at a rural interchange with I-71 west of Akron, runs across northern Ohio, picks up the Ohio Turnpike near Youngstown, and then spends more than three hundred miles crossing Pennsylvania on the turnpike mainline past Pittsburgh and Harrisburg.

At the Valley Forge interchange it leaves the toll road and becomes something entirely different — the Schuylkill Expressway, a cramped 1950s urban freeway squeezed between the river and the hillside, with short ramps, tight curves and no shoulder in places. It crosses the Delaware on the Walt Whitman Bridge and expires three miles later in New Jersey, where the same pavement carries on south as Route 42.
The number is also not unique. A separate I-76 runs across northeastern Colorado and a sliver of Nebraska; the two have never been connected and were never meant to be.
zh: 密西西比河以东的 I-76，大体上只是一条老路挂上了新编号：宾夕法尼亚收费公路。这条州际公路起自阿克伦以西与 I-71 相接的一处乡间立交，横穿俄亥俄北部，在扬斯敦附近接上俄亥俄收费公路，随后沿收费公路主线在宾夕法尼亚境内行进三百多英里，途经匹兹堡与哈里斯堡。
到了福吉谷立交，它离开收费公路，变成了完全不同的另一种东西——斯古吉尔快速路：一条 1950 年代修建的逼仄城市高速，夹在河流与山坡之间，匝道短、弯道急，有些地方连路肩都没有。它经沃尔特·惠特曼大桥跨过特拉华河，再走三英里便在新泽西终止，而同一条路面继续以 42 号州道南行。
这个编号也并非独一无二。另有一条 I-76 横穿科罗拉多东北部和内布拉斯加的一角；两者从未连通，当初也没打算连通。

en: The turnpike opened with seven two-lane tunnels through the Appalachian ridges, and those tunnels became its defining problem. Four lanes of traffic funnelled into two at each bore, and by the late 1950s the summer queues were long enough that the Commission commissioned engineering studies on what to do.

The answer was to split the difference. Four tunnels — Allegheny Mountain, Tuscarora Mountain, Kittatinny Mountain and Blue Mountain — were twinned with a second parallel bore and the original tube rehabilitated. Three others were simply abandoned: Laurel Hill was bypassed in 1964, and Rays Hill and Sideling Hill were bypassed together in 1968 by thirteen miles of new alignment with a wide median and climbing lanes.

The bypassed pavement was never torn up. A two-mile section at Laurel Hill and a longer stretch east of Breezewood still exist with their tunnels intact; the Commission has used them for testing and research, and part of the eastern section is now a trail.
zh: 收费公路通车时，穿越阿巴拉契亚山脊的隧道共有七座，都是双车道，而这些隧道后来成了它最突出的问题。四车道的车流在每一座隧道口收缩为两车道，到 1950 年代末，夏季排队之长已迫使管理委员会委托工程研究来寻找对策。
答案是折中处理。阿勒格尼山、塔斯卡罗拉山、基塔蒂尼山和蓝山四座隧道各增挖一条平行洞，并对原洞进行整修；另外三座则干脆弃用：劳雷尔山隧道 1964 年被绕行取代，雷斯山与赛德灵山两座隧道则于 1968 年由一段十三英里的新线位一并绕开，新线设有宽阔的中央分隔带和爬坡车道。
被绕开的路面从未被拆除。劳雷尔山的一段两英里路以及布里兹伍德以东更长的一段至今尚存，隧道也完好；管理委员会曾用它们做测试与研究，东段的一部分现已辟为步道。

en: The Pennsylvania Turnpike opened at midnight on 1 October 1940 as a 160-mile road between Irwin and Carlisle. It was the first long-distance, four-lane, limited-access toll highway in the United States, and it was built on the graded right-of-way and half-finished tunnels of Andrew Carnegie's abandoned South Pennsylvania Railroad.

The Commonwealth put in no money of its own. Bond markets would not touch a highway project at that scale in 1938, so the Turnpike Commission turned to New Deal agencies: the Reconstruction Finance Corporation bought the bonds and a federal grant covered the rest, with tolls pledged to repay the debt. The grant carried a deadline, which is why ground was broken in October 1938 and traffic was running less than two years later. There was no posted speed limit when it opened.

When Congress created the Interstate System in 1956 it chose to absorb the existing turnpikes rather than buy out their bonds or build free roads beside them. The Pennsylvania Turnpike kept its tolls, kept its commission, and acquired an Interstate shield.
zh: 宾夕法尼亚收费公路于 1940 年 10 月 1 日午夜通车，全长 160 英里，自欧文至卡莱尔。它是美国第一条长距离、四车道、限制出入的收费公路，修建时利用了安德鲁·卡内基那条半途而废的南宾夕法尼亚铁路已平整的路权和挖了一半的隧道。
州政府自己一分钱也没出。1938 年的债券市场不敢碰这种规模的公路项目，于是收费公路管理委员会转向新政机构：复兴金融公司买下债券，一笔联邦拨款补上其余部分，并以通行费作为偿债担保。这笔拨款附带截止期限，因此工程 1938 年 10 月破土，不到两年便通车。刚通车时，路上没有限速标志。
1956 年国会创立州际公路系统时，选择把既有的收费公路直接吸纳进来，而不是赎回它们的债券或在旁边另建免费道路。宾夕法尼亚收费公路于是保留了收费、保留了管理委员会，又多了一面州际公路盾牌。

en: The turnpike has always been a financial instrument as much as a road, and the Commission's accounts are public in a way that almost no free Interstate's are. Fare revenue and total system revenue are reported annually and audited.

Since 2007 the arithmetic has been distorted by Act 44, which obliged the Commission to hand large sums to the state for transit and non-turnpike roads. The plan assumed the state would be allowed to toll I-80; the federal government refused, three times, and the payments continued anyway, funded by borrowing. Annual obligations of $450 million ran until mid-2022 before dropping sharply, but the debt raised to make them remains outstanding and the Commission has raised tolls every year since 2009 to service it.
The figures below are for the Pennsylvania Turnpike system as a whole — the I-76 mainline plus the Northeast Extension and other facilities — because that is the unit the Commission reports.
zh: 这条收费公路从来既是一条道路，也是一件金融工具，而管理委员会的账目公开程度是几乎任何一条免费州际公路都比不上的。通行费收入与系统总收入每年披露并经审计。
2007 年以来，账面数字被《第 44 号法案》扭曲了：该法案要求管理委员会向州政府交出巨额款项，用于公共交通和收费公路之外的道路。方案原本假定州政府能获准对 I-80 收费；联邦政府三度拒绝，付款却照旧进行，靠举债维持。每年 4.5 亿美元的义务一直持续到 2022 年年中才大幅下调，但为此举借的债务仍未清偿，管理委员会自 2009 年起年年提高收费以偿付。
下列数字针对的是宾夕法尼亚收费公路系统整体——I-76 主线加上东北延伸线及其他设施——因为这才是管理委员会报告时采用的口径。

value.en: A Reconstruction Finance Corporation loan of almost $41 million at 3.75 per cent, plus about $29 million in federal grants; the Commonwealth contributed nothing

value.zh: 劳雷尔山绕行线 7,554,000 美元；新建阿勒格尼隧道逾 11,000,000 美元，旧洞整修另需约 4,000,000 美元；其余工程约 60,000,000 美元

figures.source: Pennsylvania Turnpike Commission, Maintenance Experience on the Pennsylvania Turnpike, Purdue Road School Proceedings, 1965

why.en: No agency publishes a figure for I-76 as a route. The Pennsylvania and Ohio turnpike sections are counted in toll transactions by their commissions, the free Ohio section and the Schuylkill Expressway in vehicles per day by state DOTs, and the two measures are not combined.
why.zh: 没有机构发布 I-76 作为一条路线的数字。宾夕法尼亚与俄亥俄的收费路段由各自管理委员会按通行交易笔数统计，俄亥俄的免费路段与斯古吉尔快速路则由州交通部门按日车辆数统计，两种口径无法合并。

label.zh: 宾夕法尼亚收费公路系统通行笔数

value.en: About 210 million transactions expected in calendar 2025, against more than 208 million in 2024, across a system of more than 565 miles
value.zh: 2025 日历年度预计约 2.10 亿笔，2024 年为 2.08 亿笔以上，覆盖全长逾 565 英里的系统

trafficFigures.source: Pennsylvania Turnpike Commission, How the Pennsylvania Turnpike Commission Finances One of the Nation's Longest Toll Roads, April 2025

label.en: Debt outstanding and its effect on upkeep
label.zh: 未偿债务及其对养护的影响

value.en: Nearly $16 billion of debt, largely raised to fund $8 billion of payments to the Commonwealth since 2008; annual obligations fell from $450 million to $50 million in July 2022, but tolls must keep rising through at least 2056
value.zh: 债务近 160 亿美元，主要用于支付 2008 年以来向州政府缴纳的 80 亿美元；年度义务已于 2022 年 7 月由 4.5 亿美元降至 5,000 万美元，但收费至少须持续上调至 2056 年

timeline.en: Ground is broken on 27 October for a toll highway along the abandoned South Pennsylvania Railroad right-of-way.
timeline.zh: 10 月 27 日，沿废弃的南宾夕法尼亚铁路路权修建收费公路的工程破土动工。

timeline.en: The Pennsylvania Turnpike opens on 1 October, 160 miles from Irwin to Carlisle — the first long-distance limited-access toll road in the United States.
timeline.zh: 10 月 1 日，宾夕法尼亚收费公路通车，自欧文至卡莱尔全长 160 英里，是美国第一条长距离限制出入收费公路。

timeline.en: Congress incorporates existing turnpikes into the new Interstate System rather than retiring their bonds; the Pennsylvania Turnpike keeps its tolls and gains an Interstate number.
timeline.zh: 国会将既有收费公路并入新设的州际公路系统，而非赎回其债券；宾夕法尼亚收费公路保留收费，并获得州际公路编号。

timeline.en: The Laurel Hill bypass opens on 30 October, retiring the first of the original seven tunnels.
timeline.zh: 10 月 30 日劳雷尔山绕行线通车，最初七座隧道中的第一座退役。

timeline.en: On 26 November a 13-mile bypass retires the Rays Hill and Sideling Hill tunnels, and three twinned tunnels open the same day.
timeline.zh: 11 月 26 日，一段 13 英里的绕行线令雷斯山与赛德灵山两座隧道退役，同日另有三座增挖平行洞的隧道通车。

timeline.en: Act 44 obliges the Turnpike Commission to make large annual payments to the Commonwealth, on the assumption that I-80 could be tolled. The federal government refuses; the payments continue on borrowed money.
timeline.zh: 《第 44 号法案》要求收费公路管理委员会每年向州政府支付巨额款项，其前提是 I-80 可以收费。联邦政府拒绝批准，付款则靠举债继续。

timeline.en: Open road tolling begins on 5 January east of Reading and along the entire Northeast Extension, ending cash collection on those sections.
timeline.zh: 1 月 5 日，雷丁以东路段及整条东北延伸线启用不停车收费，这些路段的现金收费就此终止。
